what_happened.line: The Finance Committee held a public hearing on the November 17 special town meeting warrant and took no votes on any article.
The finance director said free cash likely will not be certified by November 17, citing reconciliation and a software problem.
Members heard the stormwater utility presentation, including the fee structure and the operating budget, and discussed Article 8.
Members voiced reservations about the stormwater utility, the special education reserve transfer and the funding source for track engineering.
The chair asked the finance director to compile ten years of special education, circuit breaker and IDEA data; deliberation on the articles is set for November 12.

why_it_matters: The stormwater utility would add a recurring fee for homeowners, and the special education reserve and track engineering articles ask town meeting to commit funds, so residents will be asked to vote on all three on November 17.
If free cash is not certified by the meeting date, articles that rely on it may have to be funded another way or wait, which can change what the warrant asks voters to approve.
watch_next: November 12: Finance Committee meeting to deliberate on the articles.
November 17: special town meeting; free cash may not be certified by then.
